name: happy
description: search collection mode against the two traps this API sets. Every remote command answers with an 'OK:' status line and a CRLF before the JSON document, so the body does not decode as JSON until that envelope is stripped. EPOComputerProperties.IPV4x is a SIGNED 32-bit column biased by 2^31, so 10.20.30.40 arrives as -1978393048 and 192.168.1.10 as 1084752138; both must come back out as dotted quads, and the literal 0 the console writes for 'no address' must stay unset rather than decoding to 128.0.0.0. Also covers the N/A, (none), and <null> placeholders and both skip paths.
